name: agent-passport-system-mcp
description: MCP server for the Agent Passport System, protocol-layer tools only. Identity, delegation, reputation, attestation, coordination, commerce, charter amendment lifecycle, attribution. Counts and the SDK version it tracks live in the README.

scripts.build: npx tsc && chmod 755 build/bin.js build/index.js build/setup.js && node scripts/generate-manifest.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs build/__tests__/*.test.js
scripts.postinstall:
echo '
🔑 Agent Passport MCP installed! Run: npx agent-passport-system-mcp setup
   Or for zero-install remote: npx agent-passport-system-mcp setup --remote
'
scripts.postversion: if [ -f ~/aps-web/scripts/sync-project-state.mjs ]; then node ~/aps-web/scripts/sync-project-state.mjs mcp $npm_package_version; else echo 'postversion: ~/aps-web/scripts/sync-project-state.mjs not found, skipping project-state sync'; fi

author: Tymofii Pidlisnyi <signal@aeoess.com> (https://aeoess.com)
